This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where comments have been removed, empty lines have been removed.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: app/**/*, components/**/*, lib/**/*, package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, README.md
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: node_modules, .next, .git, .vercel, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, public/**/*, **/*.png, **/*.jpg, **/*.jpeg, **/*.svg, **/*.ico, **/*.pdf, **/*.lock, **/dist/**, repomix-output.txt, project-context.txt, ctx-map.txt, .claude/settings.local.json, **/.env*, .env*
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Code comments have been removed from supported file types
- Empty lines have been removed from all files
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

================
File: app/components/GoogleAnalytics.tsx
================
'use client';
import Script from 'next/script';
export default function GoogleAnalytics({ gaId }: { gaId: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Script
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${gaId}`}
        strategy="afterInteractive"
      />
      <Script id="google-analytics" strategy="afterInteractive">
        {`
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
          gtag('js', new Date());
          gtag('config', '${gaId}');
        `}
      </Script>
    </>
  );
}

import { Bricolage_Grotesque } from 'next/font/google';
const bricolage = Bricolage_Grotesque({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['500', '700', '800'],
  variable: '--font-bricolage',
  display: 'swap',
});
export default function CityLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return <div className={bricolage.variable}>{children}</div>;
}

================
File: app/events/components/DayPicker.tsx
================
'use client';
import styles from '../EventsView.module.css';
const DAY_NAMES_SHORT = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
interface DayPickerProps {
  rollingWeek: Date[];
  activeDayIdx: number;
  onSelectDay: (idx: number) => void;
  getEventCountForDay: (idx: number) => number;
}
export default function DayPicker({
  rollingWeek,
  activeDayIdx,
  onSelectDay,
  getEventCountForDay,
}: DayPickerProps) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.dayListVertical} role="group" aria-label="Day list">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const label =
            idx === 0
              ? 'Today'
              : `${DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()]} ${day.getDate()}`;
          const count = getEventCountForDay(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.dayBtnVertical} ${
                isSelected ? styles.dayBtnVerticalActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span>{label}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.dayCountText} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.dayCountTextActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count} events
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.mobileDaysGrid} role="group" aria-label="Pick day">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const dayShort = idx === 0 ? 'Today' : DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()];
          const count = getEventCountForDay(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.mobileDayBtn} ${
                isSelected ? styles.mobileDayBtnActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayLabel} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayLabelActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {dayShort}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.mobileDayNum}>{day.getDate()}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayCount} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayCountActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';
interface FilterDropdownProps {
  label: string;
  title: string;
  options: string[];
  selected: string[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggleOpen: () => void;
  onToggleOption: (option: string) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  flexStyle?: boolean;
}
export default function FilterDropdown({
  label,
  title,
  options,
  selected,
  isOpen,
  onToggleOpen,
  onToggleOption,
  onClear,
  containerRef,
  flexStyle = false,
}: FilterDropdownProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.multiSelectWrapper}
      ref={containerRef}
      style={flexStyle ? { flex: 1 } : undefined}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.multiSelectTrigger} ${
          selected.length > 0 ? styles.multiSelectTriggerActive : ''
        }`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggleOpen}
      >
        <span>{label}</span>
        <svg
          width="14"
          height="14"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2.4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
        >
          <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.multiSelectMenu}>
          <div className={styles.multiSelectMenuHeader}>
            <span>{title}</span>
            {selected.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.multiSelectClearLink}
                onClick={onClear}
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {options.map((opt) => {
            const isChecked = selected.includes(opt);
            return (
              <label key={opt} className={styles.multiSelectOption}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={isChecked}
                  onChange={() => onToggleOption(opt)}
                  className={styles.hiddenCheckbox}
                />
                <span
                  className={`${styles.customCheckbox} ${
                    isChecked ? styles.customCheckboxChecked : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {isChecked && (
                    <svg
                      width="12"
                      height="12"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                    >
                      <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span>{opt}</span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

File: app/api/send-form/route.ts
================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { Resend } from 'resend';
const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);
const recipientEmail = process.env.EMAIL_RECIPIENT;
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    if (!recipientEmail) {
      throw new Error('Recipient email is not configured.');
    }
    const body = await request.json();
    const { formType, message } = body;
    const { data, error } = await resend.emails.send({
      from: 'Someplace Social <onboarding@resend.dev>',
      to: recipientEmail,
      subject: `New Form Submission: ${formType}`,
      text: message,
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error('Resend error:', error);
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Error sending email.' }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Form submitted successfully.' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error processing form:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Server error.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

"use client";
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './Accordion.module.css';
type AccordionProps = {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
};
export default function Accordion({ title, children }: AccordionProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.header} onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}>
        {title}
        <span className={`${styles.icon} ${isOpen ? styles.iconOpen : ''}`}>
          ▼
        </span>
      </div>
      {isOpen && <div className={styles.content}>{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/[city]/page.tsx
================
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { getCityBySlug, getAllCitySlugs } from '../../lib/cities';
import { getEvents } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import CityEventsView from '../CityEventsView';
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllCitySlugs().map((city) => ({ city }));
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'City Not Found · Someplace Social',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  return {
    title: `${city.name} this week · Someplace Social`,
    description: `Weekly events, classes, and activities in ${city.heroLocation}.`,
    robots: {
      index: false,
      follow: false,
    },
  };
}
export default async function CityEventsPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  const events = await getEvents(city);
  const allSlugs = getAllCitySlugs();
  const countEntries = await Promise.all(
    allSlugs.map(async (slug) => {
      const c = getCityBySlug(slug);
      if (!c) return [slug, 0] as const;
      if (c.slug === city.slug) return [slug, events.length] as const;
      const otherEvents = await getEvents(c);
      return [slug, otherEvents.length] as const;
    })
  );
  const cityCounts = Object.fromEntries(countEntries);
  return (
    <CityEventsView
      city={city}
      initialEvents={events}
      initialCityCounts={cityCounts}
    />
  );
}

================
File: app/components/ContactForm.tsx
================
"use client";
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './ContactForm.module.css';
type ContactFormProps = {
  formType: string;
  fields: readonly { name: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; type: 'text' | 'email' | 'textarea'; required: boolean }[];
};
export default function ContactForm({ formType, fields }: ContactFormProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setStatus('Submitting...');
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    let message = '';
    formData.forEach((value, key) => {
      message += `${key}: ${value}\n`;
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ formType, message }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setStatus('Message sent successfully!');
        (event.target as HTMLFormElement).reset();
      } else {
        setStatus('Failed to send message. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus('An error occurred. Please try again.');
    }
  };
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={styles.form}>
      {fields.map(field => (
        <div key={field.name} className={styles.field}>
          <label htmlFor={field.name}>{field.label}</label>
          {field.type === 'textarea' ? (
            <textarea
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.textarea}
            />
          ) : (
            <input
              type={field.type}
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.input}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button type="submit" className={styles.button}>Send Message</button>
      {status && <p>{status}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

File: app/events/components/FilterControls.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import FilterDropdown from './FilterDropdown';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';
interface FilterControlsProps {
  searchQuery: string;
  onSearchChange: (query: string) => void;
  freeOnly: boolean;
  onToggleFree: () => void;
  timeSections: string[];
  selectedTimes: string[];
  onToggleTime: (timeName: string) => void;
  onClearTimes: () => void;
  activities: string[];
  selectedActivities: string[];
  onToggleActivity: (act: string) => void;
  onClearActivities: () => void;
  areas: string[];
  selectedAreas: string[];
  onToggleArea: (ar: string) => void;
  onClearAreas: () => void;
  hasActiveFilters: boolean;
  onClearAllFilters: () => void;
}
export default function FilterControls({
  searchQuery,
  onSearchChange,
  freeOnly,
  onToggleFree,
  timeSections,
  selectedTimes,
  onToggleTime,
  onClearTimes,
  activities,
  selectedActivities,
  onToggleActivity,
  onClearActivities,
  areas,
  selectedAreas,
  onToggleArea,
  onClearAreas,
  hasActiveFilters,
  onClearAllFilters,
}: FilterControlsProps) {
  const [timeMenuOpen, setTimeMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [actMenuOpen, setActMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [areaMenuOpen, setAreaMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const timeMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const actMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const areaMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (timeMenuRef.current && !timeMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setTimeMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (actMenuRef.current && !actMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setActMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (areaMenuRef.current && !areaMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setAreaMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);
  const timeLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedTimes.length === 0) return 'All times';
    if (selectedTimes.length === 1) return selectedTimes[0];
    return `Times (${selectedTimes.length})`;
  }, [selectedTimes]);
  const activityLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedActivities.length === 0) return 'All activities';
    if (selectedActivities.length === 1) return selectedActivities[0];
    return `Activities (${selectedActivities.length})`;
  }, [selectedActivities]);
  const areaLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedAreas.length === 0) return 'All areas';
    if (selectedAreas.length === 1) return selectedAreas[0];
    return `Areas (${selectedAreas.length})`;
  }, [selectedAreas]);
  const renderSearchInput = () => (
    <div className={styles.searchWrapper}>
      <svg
        className={styles.searchIcon}
        width="16"
        height="16"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth="2.2"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
        <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35" />
      </svg>
      <input
        type="text"
        value={searchQuery}
        onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Search events, places, tags..."
        className={styles.searchInput}
        aria-label="Search events"
        autoComplete="off"
        spellCheck={false}
      />
      {searchQuery && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.searchClearBtn}
          onClick={() => onSearchChange('')}
          aria-label="Clear search query"
        >
          <svg
            width="13"
            height="13"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.filterBlockDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.filterHeaderRow}>
          <span className={styles.filterTitle}>Filters</span>
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.clearFiltersLink}
              onClick={onClearAllFilters}
            >
              Reset all
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filterListVertical}>
          {renderSearchInput()}
          <FilterDropdown
            label={activityLabel}
            title="Select activities"
            options={activities}
            selected={selectedActivities}
            isOpen={actMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setActMenuOpen(!actMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleActivity}
            onClear={onClearActivities}
            containerRef={actMenuRef}
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            label={timeLabel}
            title="Time of day"
            options={timeSections}
            selected={selectedTimes}
            isOpen={timeMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setTimeMenuOpen(!timeMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleTime}
            onClear={onClearTimes}
            containerRef={timeMenuRef}
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            label={areaLabel}
            title="Select areas"
            options={areas}
            selected={selectedAreas}
            isOpen={areaMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setAreaMenuOpen(!areaMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleArea}
            onClear={onClearAreas}
            containerRef={areaMenuRef}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.filterFreeBtn}
            aria-pressed={freeOnly}
            onClick={onToggleFree}
          >
            Free only
            <span
              className={`${styles.checkboxSquare} ${
                freeOnly ? styles.checkboxChecked : ''
              }`}
            >
              {freeOnly && (
                <svg
                  width="12"
                  height="12"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="3"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                </svg>
              )}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.mobileFiltersSection}>
        {renderSearchInput()}
        <div className={styles.mobileFiltersRow}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`${styles.mobileFreeBtn} ${freeOnly ? styles.mobileFreeBtnActive : ''}`}
            onClick={onToggleFree}
          >
            Free only
          </button>
          <FilterDropdown
            label={timeLabel}
            title="Time of day"
            options={timeSections}
            selected={selectedTimes}
            isOpen={timeMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setTimeMenuOpen(!timeMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleTime}
            onClear={onClearTimes}
            flexStyle
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            label={activityLabel}
            title="Activities"
            options={activities}
            selected={selectedActivities}
            isOpen={actMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setActMenuOpen(!actMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleActivity}
            onClear={onClearActivities}
            flexStyle
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            label={areaLabel}
            title="Areas"
            options={areas}
            selected={selectedAreas}
            isOpen={areaMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setAreaMenuOpen(!areaMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleArea}
            onClear={onClearAreas}
            flexStyle
          />
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.clearFiltersBtn}
              onClick={onClearAllFilters}
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Event } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import styles from './SuggestEditModal.module.css';
interface SuggestEditModalProps {
  event: Event;
  cityName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}
export default function SuggestEditModal({
  event,
  cityName,
  onClose,
}: SuggestEditModalProps) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(
    `City: ${cityName}\nEvent: ${event.title}\nVenue: ${event.venue || event.location}\nTime: ${event.startTime} - ${event.endTime}\nFrequency: ${event.frequency || 'Weekly'}${event.frequencyNotes ? ` (${event.frequencyNotes})` : ''}\nLocation: ${event.location} (${event.area})${event.preRegistration ? `\nPre-Registration: ${event.preRegistration}` : ''}\n\nRequested changes: `
  );
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setStatus('Submitting update...');
    try {
      const fullMessage = `Sender Email: ${email || 'Not provided'}\n\n${message}`;
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: `Edit a Listing (${cityName})`,
          message: fullMessage,
        }),
      });
      const res = await response.json();
      if (res.success) {
        setStatus('Thanks! Your edit suggestion has been sent.');
        setTimeout(onClose, 1800);
      } else {
        setStatus('Failed to send. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('An error occurred. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className={styles.modalBackdrop} onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        className={styles.modalContent}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
      >
        <div className={styles.modalHeader}>
          <div>
            <h2 className={styles.modalTitle}>Suggest Edit</h2>
            <small className={styles.modalSubtitle}>{event.title}</small>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.modalCloseBtn}
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={styles.modalForm}>
          <div className={styles.modalField}>
            <label htmlFor="editEmail">Your Email (optional)</label>
            <input
              id="editEmail"
              type="email"
              className={styles.modalInput}
              placeholder="name@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.modalField}>
            <label htmlFor="editMessage">What needs to be changed? *</label>
            <textarea
              id="editMessage"
              required
              className={styles.modalTextarea}
              value={message}
              onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.modalActions}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.modalCancelBtn}
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className={styles.modalSubmitBtn}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Edit'}
            </button>
          </div>
          {status && <p className={styles.statusMsg}>{status}</p>}
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: app/events/utils.ts

import { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
export function parseHour(timeStr: string): number {
  if (!timeStr) return 18;
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  const match = cleaned.match(/(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?/i);
  if (match) {
    let hour = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    const minute = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : 0;
    const meridian = match[3];
    if (meridian) {
      const isPm = meridian.startsWith('p');
      const isAm = meridian.startsWith('a');
      if (isPm && hour < 12) hour += 12;
      if (isAm && hour === 12) hour = 0;
    } else {
      if (hour >= 1 && hour <= 6) {
        hour += 12;
      }
    }
    return hour + minute / 60;
  }
  const numMatch = cleaned.match(/\d+/);
  return numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : 18;
}
export function formatTimeLabel(timeStr: string): string {
  if (!timeStr) return '';
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim();
  const match = cleaned.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?$/i);
  if (match) {
    const hour = match[1];
    const minute = match[2] && match[2] !== '00' ? `:${match[2]}` : '';
    const meridian = (match[3] || 'p').toLowerCase().startsWith('a') ? 'a' : 'p';
    return `${hour}${minute}${meridian}`;
  }
  return cleaned;
}
export function formatTimeRange(
  startTime: string,
  endTime: string
): { start: string; end?: string } {
  const start = formatTimeLabel(startTime);
  const end = endTime ? formatTimeLabel(endTime) : undefined;
  return { start, end };
}
export function isFreePrice(price: string): boolean {
  if (!price) return true;
  const p = price.trim().toLowerCase();
  return p.startsWith('free') || p.startsWith('gratis') || p === '0' || p === '$0';
}
const DAY_ALIAS_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  sun: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  sunday: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  mon: ['mon', 'monday'],
  monday: ['mon', 'monday'],
  tue: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  tuesday: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  wed: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  wednesday: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  thu: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  thursday: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  fri: ['fri', 'friday'],
  friday: ['fri', 'friday'],
  sat: ['sat', 'saturday'],
  saturday: ['sat', 'saturday'],
};
export function normalizeDayOfWeek(dayStr: string): string {
  if (!dayStr) return '';
  const trimmed = dayStr.trim();
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('daily') || lower.includes('everyday') || lower.includes('every day')) {
    return 'Daily';
  }
  const tokens = trimmed.split(/[^a-zA-Z]+/).filter(Boolean);
  const DAY_TO_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
    sun: 'Sun',
    sunday: 'Sun',
    mon: 'Mon',
    monday: 'Mon',
    tue: 'Tue',
    tues: 'Tue',
    tuesday: 'Tue',
    wed: 'Wed',
    weds: 'Wed',
    wednesday: 'Wed',
    thu: 'Thu',
    thur: 'Thu',
    thurs: 'Thu',
    thursday: 'Thu',
    fri: 'Fri',
    friday: 'Fri',
    sat: 'Sat',
    saturday: 'Sat',
  };
  const normalized: string[] = [];
  for (const token of tokens) {
    const short = DAY_TO_SHORT[token.toLowerCase()];
    if (short && !normalized.includes(short)) {
      normalized.push(short);
    }
  }
  return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized.join(', ') : trimmed;
}
export function matchesDay(eventDays: string, targetDayName: string): boolean {
  if (!eventDays || !targetDayName) return false;
  const targetKey = targetDayName.trim().toLowerCase();
  const aliases = DAY_ALIAS_MAP[targetKey] || [targetKey];
  const rawLower = eventDays.toLowerCase();
  if (rawLower.includes('daily') || rawLower.includes('everyday') || rawLower.includes('every day')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (rawLower.includes(targetKey)) {
    return true;
  }
  const tokens = rawLower.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
  return tokens.some((token) => aliases.includes(token));
}
const MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM: Record<string, number> = {
  jan: 1,
  january: 1,
  feb: 2,
  february: 2,
  mar: 3,
  march: 3,
  apr: 4,
  april: 4,
  may: 5,
  jun: 6,
  june: 6,
  jul: 7,
  july: 7,
  aug: 8,
  august: 8,
  sep: 9,
  sept: 9,
  september: 9,
  oct: 10,
  october: 10,
  nov: 11,
  november: 11,
  dec: 12,
  december: 12,
};
function parseMonthIndex(str: string): number | null {
  const cleaned = str.trim().toLowerCase();
  return MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[cleaned] ?? null;
}
export function isMonthActive(frequencyNotes: string, targetDate: Date): boolean {
  if (!frequencyNotes) return true;
  const cleaned = frequencyNotes.trim();
  if (!cleaned) return true;
  if (/^irregular/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return false;
  }
  const targetMonth = targetDate.getMonth() + 1;
  if (/months?,\s*even/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth % 2 === 0;
  }
  if (/months?,\s*odd/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth % 2 !== 0;
  }
  const rangeMatch = cleaned.match(/months?,\s*([a-zA-Z]+)\s*[\u2013\u2014\-]\s*([a-zA-Z]+)/i);
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startMonth = parseMonthIndex(rangeMatch[1]);
    const endMonth = parseMonthIndex(rangeMatch[2]);
    if (startMonth && endMonth) {
      if (startMonth <= endMonth) {
        return targetMonth >= startMonth && targetMonth <= endMonth;
      }
      return targetMonth >= startMonth || targetMonth <= endMonth;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
export function getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate: Date): {
  occurrence: number;
  isLast: boolean;
} {
  const dayOfMonth = targetDate.getDate();
  const occurrence = Math.ceil(dayOfMonth / 7);
  const daysInMonth = new Date(
    targetDate.getFullYear(),
    targetDate.getMonth() + 1,
    0
  ).getDate();
  const isLast = dayOfMonth + 7 > daysInMonth;
  return { occurrence, isLast };
}
function getWeekNumber(d: Date): number {
  const target = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  const dayNum = target.getUTCDay() || 7;
  target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(target.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil(((target.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
}
export function isEventActiveOnDate(event: Event, targetDate: Date): boolean {
  const notes = (event.frequencyNotes || '').trim();
  if (/^irregular/i.test(notes)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!isMonthActive(notes, targetDate)) {
    return false;
  }
  const DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];
  const targetDayName = DAY_NAMES[targetDate.getDay()];
  const daySpec = `${event.dayOfWeek || ''} ${event.frequency || ''}`;
  if (!matchesDay(daySpec, targetDayName)) {
    return false;
  }
  const rawFreq = (event.frequency || '').trim();
  if (!rawFreq) {
    return true;
  }
  const parts = rawFreq.split(',').map((p) => p.trim());
  const cadence = parts[0]?.toLowerCase() || 'weekly';
  const pattern = (parts.slice(1).join(',') || '').toLowerCase();
  const { occurrence, isLast } = getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate);
  const ordinalMatches: boolean[] = [];
  if (/\b1st\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(occurrence === 1);
  if (/\b2nd\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(occurrence === 2);
  if (/\b3rd\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(occurrence === 3);
  if (/\b4th\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(occurrence === 4);
  if (/\b5th\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(occurrence === 5);
  if (/\blast\b/.test(pattern)) ordinalMatches.push(isLast);
  if (cadence.includes('monthly') || cadence.includes('bi-monthly')) {
    if (ordinalMatches.length > 0) {
      return ordinalMatches.some(Boolean);
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (cadence.includes('bi-weekly')) {
    if (ordinalMatches.length > 0) {
      return ordinalMatches.some(Boolean);
    }
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    return weekNum % 2 === 0;
  }
  return true;
}
export function ensureExternalUrl(url: string): string {
  if (!url) return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  return `https://${trimmed}`;
}
export function getTagStyle(tag: string): { color: string; background: string } {
  const t = (tag || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes('science')) {
    return { color: '#0f5c5c', background: '#d3efec' };
  }
  if (t.includes('craft')) {
    return { color: '#8a3d0c', background: '#fde4cf' };
  }
  if (t.includes('food') || t.includes('drink')) {
    return { color: '#6b5200', background: '#f4eab8' };
  }
  if (t.includes('community') || t.includes('social')) {
    return { color: '#3b4a54', background: '#e1e7ea' };
  }
  if (t.includes('music') || t.includes('bluegrass')) {
    return { color: '#5b2a86', background: '#ecdcf7' };
  }
  if (t.includes('trivia')) {
    return { color: '#2d3f7a', background: '#dde4f7' };
  }
  if (t.includes('open mic') || t.includes('mic') || t.includes('comedy')) {
    return { color: '#8a1f4f', background: '#fbdce9' };
  }
  if (t.includes('dance') || t.includes('salsa') || t.includes('bachata')) {
    return { color: '#852b2b', background: '#f9dede' };
  }
  if (t.includes('sport') || t.includes('fitness') || t.includes('yoga') || t.includes('walk')) {
    return { color: '#1f6a42', background: '#d7f0df' };
  }
  if (t.includes('language') || t.includes('english') || t.includes('spanish')) {
    return { color: '#2c4f7c', background: '#dbe5f7' };
  }
  return { color: '#4f483e', background: '#f3ead4' };
}

export type CityConfig = {
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  region: string;
  heroLocation: string;
  sheetTab: string;
  sheetGid?: string;
  spreadsheetId?: string;
  csvUrl?: string;
};
export const MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID = '1dl6clB28uxBDz9Vq6B4H9l2N2iu1ayTBkPDCkiWsHsU';
export const CITIES: Record<string, CityConfig> = {
  'medellin-colombia': {
    slug: 'medellin-colombia',
    name: 'Medellín',
    region: 'Colombia',
    heroLocation: 'Medellín, Colombia',
    sheetTab: 'Medellin',
    sheetGid: '0',
    spreadsheetId: MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID,
  },
  'fort-collins-colorado': {
    slug: 'fort-collins-colorado',
    name: 'Fort Collins',
    region: 'Colorado',
    heroLocation: 'Fort Collins, Colorado',
    sheetTab: 'Fort Collins',
    sheetGid: '466758538',
    spreadsheetId: MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID,
  },
};
export function getCityBySlug(slug: string): CityConfig | undefined {
  if (!slug) return undefined;
  const normalized = slug.toLowerCase().trim();
  return CITIES[normalized];
}
export function getAllCitySlugs(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(CITIES);
}
export function getAllCities(): CityConfig[] {
  return Object.values(CITIES);
}

================
File: app/events/CityEventsView.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { CityConfig, getAllCities } from '../lib/cities';
import { getEvents, Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import { parseHour, isFreePrice, isEventActiveOnDate } from './utils';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import Footer from '../components/Footer';
import DayPicker from './components/DayPicker';
import FilterControls from './components/FilterControls';
import EventCard from './components/EventCard';
import SuggestEditModal from './components/SuggestEditModal';
import styles from './EventsView.module.css';
const DAY_NAMES_LONG = [
  'Sunday',
  'Monday',
  'Tuesday',
  'Wednesday',
  'Thursday',
  'Friday',
  'Saturday',
];
const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];
const TIME_GROUPS = [
  { name: 'Morning', predicate: (h: number) => h < 12 },
  { name: 'Afternoon', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 12 && h < 17 },
  { name: 'Evening', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 17 && h < 20 },
  { name: 'Night', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 20 },
];
export default function CityEventsView({
  city,
  initialEvents = [],
  initialCityCounts = {},
}: {
  city: CityConfig;
  initialEvents?: Event[];
  initialCityCounts?: Record<string, number>;
}) {
  const [allEvents, setAllEvents] = useState<Event[]>(initialEvents);
  const [cityCounts, setCityCounts] = useState<Record<string, number>>(initialCityCounts);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(initialEvents.length === 0);
  const [activeDayIdx, setActiveDayIdx] = useState(0);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [freeOnly, setFreeOnly] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTimes, setSelectedTimes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedActivities, setSelectedActivities] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAreas, setSelectedAreas] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [openEventId, setOpenEventId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editModalEvent, setEditModalEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialEvents.length === 0) {
      setLoading(true);
      getEvents(city)
        .then((data) => {
          setAllEvents(data);
          setCityCounts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [city.slug]: data.length }));
        })
        .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    } else {
      setAllEvents(initialEvents);
      setCityCounts((prev) => ({ ...prev, [city.slug]: initialEvents.length }));
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [city, initialEvents]);
  const rollingWeek = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
      return d;
    });
  }, []);
  const activeDate = rollingWeek[activeDayIdx] || rollingWeek[0];
  const now = new Date();
  const nowHour = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes() / 60;
  const activities = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      ev.activities.forEach((act) => {
        const trimmed = act.trim();
        if (trimmed) set.add(trimmed);
      });
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allEvents]);
  const areas = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      if (ev.area && ev.area.trim().length > 0 && ev.area.trim().length < 35) {
        set.add(ev.area.trim());
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allEvents]);
  const toggleTime = (tName: string) => {
    setSelectedTimes((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tName) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tName) : [...prev, tName]
    );
  };
  const toggleActivity = (act: string) => {
    setSelectedActivities((prev) =>
      prev.includes(act) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== act) : [...prev, act]
    );
  };
  const toggleArea = (ar: string) => {
    setSelectedAreas((prev) =>
      prev.includes(ar) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== ar) : [...prev, ar]
    );
  };
  const getFilteredEventsForDay = (dayIndex: number) => {
    const day = rollingWeek[dayIndex];
    if (!day) return [];
    return allEvents
      .filter((ev) => {
        if (!isEventActiveOnDate(ev, day)) return false;
        if (freeOnly && !isFreePrice(ev.price)) return false;
        const evHour = parseHour(ev.startTime);
        if (selectedTimes.length > 0) {
          const matchesTime = selectedTimes.some((tgName) => {
            const group = TIME_GROUPS.find((g) => g.name === tgName);
            return group ? group.predicate(evHour) : false;
          });
          if (!matchesTime) return false;
        }
        if (selectedActivities.length > 0) {
          const acts = ev.activities.map((a) => a.trim().toLowerCase());
          const hasActivityMatch = selectedActivities.some((sa) =>
            acts.includes(sa.toLowerCase())
          );
          if (!hasActivityMatch) return false;
        }
        if (selectedAreas.length > 0) {
          const areaLower = (ev.area || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const hasAreaMatch = selectedAreas.some(
            (sa) => sa.toLowerCase() === areaLower
          );
          if (!hasAreaMatch) return false;
        }
        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
          const queryTerms = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
          const searchableText = [
            ev.title,
            ev.venue,
            ev.organization,
            ev.location,
            ev.area,
            ev.activity,
            ...ev.activities,
            ev.about,
            ev.notes,
          ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(' ')
            .toLowerCase();
          const matchesSearch = queryTerms.every((term) => searchableText.includes(term));
          if (!matchesSearch) return false;
        }
        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => parseHour(a.startTime) - parseHour(b.startTime));
  };
  const currentList = useMemo(() => {
    return getFilteredEventsForDay(activeDayIdx);
  }, [allEvents, activeDayIdx, freeOnly, selectedTimes, selectedActivities, selectedAreas, searchQuery, rollingWeek]);
  const nextUpEventId = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeDayIdx !== 0) return null;
    const nextEvent = currentList.find((ev) => parseHour(ev.startTime) >= nowHour);
    return nextEvent ? nextEvent.id || nextEvent.title : null;
  }, [activeDayIdx, currentList, nowHour]);
  const hasActiveFilters =
    searchQuery.trim().length > 0 ||
    freeOnly ||
    selectedTimes.length > 0 ||
    selectedActivities.length > 0 ||
    selectedAreas.length > 0;
  const clearAllFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setFreeOnly(false);
    setSelectedTimes([]);
    setSelectedActivities([]);
    setSelectedAreas([]);
  };
  const allCityOptions = useMemo(() => getAllCities(), []);
  const dayHeading =
    activeDayIdx === 0
      ? 'Today'
      : activeDayIdx === 1
      ? 'Tomorrow'
      : DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()];
  const daySubheading = `${DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()]}, ${activeDate.getDate()} ${
    MONTH_NAMES[activeDate.getMonth()]
  } · ${currentList.length} ${currentList.length === 1 ? 'thing' : 'things'} on`;
  return (
    <div className={styles.pageContainer}>
      <Header
        city={city}
        allCityOptions={allCityOptions}
        cityCounts={cityCounts}
      />
      <main className={styles.mainLayout}>
        <aside className={styles.aside}>
          <h1 className={styles.asideTitle}>{dayHeading}</h1>
          <p className={styles.asideSubtitle}>{daySubheading}</p>
          <DayPicker
            rollingWeek={rollingWeek}
            activeDayIdx={activeDayIdx}
            onSelectDay={(idx) => {
              setActiveDayIdx(idx);
              setOpenEventId(null);
            }}
            getEventCountForDay={(idx) => getFilteredEventsForDay(idx).length}
          />
          <FilterControls
            searchQuery={searchQuery}
            onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
            freeOnly={freeOnly}
            onToggleFree={() => setFreeOnly(!freeOnly)}
            timeSections={TIME_GROUPS.map((g) => g.name)}
            selectedTimes={selectedTimes}
            onToggleTime={toggleTime}
            onClearTimes={() => setSelectedTimes([])}
            activities={activities}
            selectedActivities={selectedActivities}
            onToggleActivity={toggleActivity}
            onClearActivities={() => setSelectedActivities([])}
            areas={areas}
            selectedAreas={selectedAreas}
            onToggleArea={toggleArea}
            onClearAreas={() => setSelectedAreas([])}
            hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
            onClearAllFilters={clearAllFilters}
          />
        </aside>
        <section className={styles.contentCol}>
          <div className={styles.mobileSectionHeader}>
            <h1 className={styles.mobileHeadingTitle}>{dayHeading}</h1>
            <p className={styles.mobileHeadingSubtitle}>{daySubheading}</p>
          </div>
          {loading ? (
            <div className={styles.emptyState}>
              <b className={styles.emptyStateTitle}>Loading {city.name} events...</b>
              Gathering up-to-date weekly community activities.
            </div>
          ) : currentList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className={styles.emptyState}>
              <b className={styles.emptyStateTitle}>
                Nothing listed{hasActiveFilters ? ' with these filters' : ''}
              </b>
              {hasActiveFilters
                ? 'Try clearing your filters to see more events.'
                : 'Know an event or group happening on this day? Submit it above.'}
            </div>
          ) : (
            TIME_GROUPS.map((group) => {
              const groupEvents = currentList.filter((ev) =>
                group.predicate(parseHour(ev.startTime))
              );
              if (groupEvents.length === 0) return null;
              return (
                <div key={group.name}>
                  <div className={styles.timeGroupHeader}>
                    {group.name}
                    <div className={styles.timeGroupLine} />
                  </div>
                  {groupEvents.map((ev, i) => {
                    const uniqueId = ev.id || `${ev.title}-${i}`;
                    return (
                      <EventCard
                        key={uniqueId}
                        event={ev}
                        isOpen={openEventId === uniqueId}
                        isNextUp={uniqueId === nextUpEventId}
                        cityName={city.name}
                        onToggle={() =>
                          setOpenEventId(openEventId === uniqueId ? null : uniqueId)
                        }
                        onOpenEdit={setEditModalEvent}
                      />
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </section>
      </main>
      <Footer />
      {editModalEvent && (
        <SuggestEditModal
          event={editModalEvent}
          cityName={city.name}
          onClose={() => setEditModalEvent(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/components/EventCard.tsx

'use client';
import { Event } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  formatTimeRange,
  isFreePrice,
  ensureExternalUrl,
  getTagStyle,
} from '../utils';
import styles from './EventCard.module.css';
interface EventCardProps {
  event: Event;
  isOpen: boolean;
  isNextUp: boolean;
  cityName: string;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onOpenEdit: (ev: Event) => void;
}
function ActionButton({
  href,
  label,
  icon,
}: {
  href?: string;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  if (href) {
    return (
      <a
        href={ensureExternalUrl(href)}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
      >
        {icon}
        {label}
      </a>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.actionBtnOutline}
      style={{ opacity: 0.45, cursor: 'not-allowed' }}
    >
      {icon}
      {label}
    </div>
  );
}
export default function EventCard({
  event,
  isOpen,
  isNextUp,
  cityName,
  onToggle,
  onOpenEdit,
}: EventCardProps) {
  const { start, end } = formatTimeRange(event.startTime, event.endTime);
  const isFree = isFreePrice(event.price);
  const tagList = event.activities || [];
  const displayVenue = event.venue || event.location;
  const recurrenceText = event.frequency
    ? `${event.frequency}${event.frequencyNotes ? ` (${event.frequencyNotes})` : ''}`
    : event.frequencyNotes || '';
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.eventCard} ${isOpen ? styles.eventCardOpen : ''}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.cardRow}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        <div className={styles.timeCol}>
          {start}
          {end && <div className={styles.endTimeText}>to {end}</div>}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.infoCol}>
          {isNextUp && <span className={styles.nextUpBadge}>Next up</span>}
          <div className={styles.eventTitle}>
            {event.title}
            {event.organization && event.organization !== displayVenue && (
              <span className={styles.eventHost}> w/ {event.organization}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.eventLocation}>
            {displayVenue}
            {event.area ? ` · ${event.area}` : ''}
          </div>
          <div className={`${styles.priceLine} ${isFree ? styles.priceFree : styles.pricePaid}`}>
            <svg
              width="15"
              height="15"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2.2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            >
              <path d="M3 12V4h8l10 10-8 8L3 12z" />
              <circle cx="7.5" cy="8.5" r="1" />
            </svg>
            {isFree ? 'Free' : event.price || 'Varies'}
          </div>
          {tagList.length > 0 && (
            <div className={styles.tagList}>
              {tagList.map((tag) => {
                const customStyle = getTagStyle(tag);
                return (
                  <span
                    key={tag}
                    className={styles.tagChip}
                    style={{
                      color: customStyle.color,
                      backgroundColor: customStyle.background,
                    }}
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`${styles.chevronCircle} ${
            isOpen ? styles.chevronCircleOpen : ''
          }`}
        >
          <svg
            width="16"
            height="16"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2.4"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.expandedDrawer}>
          {(event.about || event.notes) && (
            <p className={styles.eventDescription}>{event.about || event.notes}</p>
          )}
          {recurrenceText && (
            <p
              className={styles.eventDescription}
              style={{
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: 'var(--ink)',
                marginBottom: event.preRegistration ? 8 : 14,
              }}
            >
              📅Recurs: {recurrenceText}
            </p>
          )}
          {event.preRegistration && (
            <p
              className={styles.eventDescription}
              style={{
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: 'var(--ink)',
                marginBottom: 14,
              }}
            >
              📝Pre-Registration: {event.preRegistration}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className={styles.drawerActionRow}>
            <div className={styles.buttonGrid4}>
              <a
                href={
                  event.map
                    ? ensureExternalUrl(event.map)
                    : `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
                        `${displayVenue}, ${cityName}`
                      )}`
                }
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className={styles.actionBtnPrimary}
                aria-label="Open in Maps"
              >
                <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                  <path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11a7 7 0 0114 0c0 4.8-7 11-7 11z" />
                  <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5" />
                </svg>
                Maps
              </a>
              <ActionButton
                href={event.website}
                label="Website"
                icon={
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
                    <path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.2 3 14.8 0 18M12 3c-3 3.2-3 14.8 0 18" />
                  </svg>
                }
              />
              <ActionButton
                href={event.social}
                label="Instagram"
                icon={
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="17" height="17" rx="5" />
                    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
                    <circle cx="17.2" cy="6.8" r=".6" />
                  </svg>
                }
              />
              <ActionButton
                href={event.contact}
                label="Contact"
                icon={
                  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                    <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" />
                    <path d="M3.5 6.5l8.5 6.5 8.5-6.5" />
                  </svg>
                }
              />
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.suggestEditBtn}
              onClick={() => onOpenEdit(event)}
            >
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <path d="M4 20l1-4L16.5 4.5a2 2 0 013 3L8 19l-4 1z" />
              </svg>
              Suggest edit
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { Karla, Bricolage_Grotesque } from 'next/font/google';
import './globals.css';
import GoogleAnalytics from './components/GoogleAnalytics';
import { Analytics } from '@vercel/analytics/react';
const karla = Karla({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '500', '700'],
  variable: '--font-karla',
  display: 'swap',
});
const bricolage = Bricolage_Grotesque({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['500', '700', '800'],
  variable: '--font-bricolage',
  display: 'swap',
});
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL('https://www.someplacesocial.org'),
  title: {
    default: 'Someplace Social | Community Event Listings',
    template: '%s | Someplace Social',
  },
  description:
    'Community supported events, group activities, and weekly classes all in one place. Find traveler friendly language exchanges, free salsa classes, and more.',
  icons: {
    icon: '/icon.png',
    apple: '/apple-icon.png',
  },
};

================
File: app/lib/google-sheets.ts
================
import { CityConfig, CITIES, MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID } from './cities';
import { normalizeDayOfWeek } from '../events/utils';
export type Event = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  venue: string;
  organization: string;
  location: string;
  area: string;
  activity: string;
  activities: string[];
  dayOfWeek: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  frequency: string;
  frequencyNotes: string;
  price: string;
  preRegistration: string;
  map: string;
  social: string;
  website: string;
  contact: string;
  about: string;
  notes: string;
  database: string;
};
const BASE_PUB_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vS2zEDH8-8__S6s0_a0evopp5lh0e34Tv0_fPcPQetnhed1kXHCCGNhIsXen_za-xB8SpS9CIdZaH9C/pub';
function getCandidateUrls(city: CityConfig): string[] {
  if (city.csvUrl) return [city.csvUrl];
  const targetId = city.spreadsheetId || MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const tabs = [city.sheetTab];
  if (city.sheetTab.toLowerCase() === 'medellin') {
    tabs.push('Medellín');
  } else if (city.sheetTab.toLowerCase() === 'fort collins') {
    tabs.push('FortCollins');
  }
  const urls: string[] = [];
  for (const tab of tabs) {
    const encodedTab = encodeURIComponent(tab);
    urls.push(`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodedTab}`);
    urls.push(`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?sheet=${encodedTab}`);
  }
  if (city.sheetGid) {
    urls.push(`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${city.sheetGid}`);
    urls.push(`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/export?format=csv&gid=${city.sheetGid}`);
    urls.push(`${BASE_PUB_URL}?gid=${city.sheetGid}&single=true&output=csv`);
  }
  urls.push(`${BASE_PUB_URL}?sheet=${encodeURIComponent(city.sheetTab)}&single=true&output=csv`);
  return urls;
}
function parseCsv(csvText: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let currentRow: string[] = [];
  let currentField = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < csvText.length; i++) {
    const char = csvText[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (inQuotes && csvText[i + 1] === '"') {
        currentField += '"';
        i++;
      } else {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      currentField = '';
    } else if ((char === '\n' || char === '\r') && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      rows.push(currentRow);
      currentRow = [];
      currentField = '';
      if (char === '\r' && csvText[i + 1] === '\n') {
        i++;
      }
    } else {
      currentField += char;
    }
  }
  currentRow.push(currentField);
  rows.push(currentRow);
  return rows;
}
function parseSheetData(rawText: string): string[][] {
  const trimmed = rawText.trim();
  if (trimmed.includes('google.visualization.Query.setResponse') || trimmed.startsWith('/*O_o*/')) {
    try {
      const startIdx = trimmed.indexOf('{');
      const endIdx = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
        const jsonStr = trimmed.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 1);
        const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        if (data.status === 'error') {
          return [];
        }
        if (data.table) {
          const cols: { label?: string; id?: string }[] = data.table.cols || [];
          const headerRow: string[] = cols.map((col) => col.label || col.id || '');
          const dataRows: string[][] = (data.table.rows || []).map((row: { c?: ({ v?: unknown; f?: string } | null)[] }) => {
            return (row.c || []).map((cell) => {
              if (!cell || cell.v === null || cell.v === undefined) return '';
              return String(cell.f || cell.v).trim();
            });
          });
          if (headerRow.some((h: string) => Boolean(h && !h.match(/^[A-Z]$/)))) {
            return [headerRow, ...dataRows];
          } else if (dataRows.length > 0) {
            return dataRows;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Someplace Social] Failed to parse GViz JSON, falling back to CSV parser:', e);
    }
  }
  return parseCsv(rawText);
}
const normalizeHeader = (header: string): string => header.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
const HEADER_ALIASES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  id: ['id'],
  title: ['title', 'eventname', 'name'],
  venue: ['venue', 'place'],
  organization: ['organization', 'organizer', 'host'],
  location: ['location', 'address'],
  area: ['area', 'neighborhood'],
  activity: ['activity', 'activities'],
  activity1: ['activity1', 'activity'],
  activity2: ['activity2'],
  activity3: ['activity3'],
  dayOfWeek: ['dayofweek', 'day', 'days', 'daysofweek'],
  startTime: ['starttime', 'start'],
  endTime: ['endtime', 'end'],
  frequency: ['frequency', 'cadence', 'recurrence', 'howoften'],
  frequencyNotes: [
    'frequencynotes',
    'frequencynote',
    'frequency_notes',
    'freqnotes',
    'freqnote',
    'frequencynot',
    'recurrencenotes',
  ],
  price: ['price', 'cost'],
  preRegistration: ['preregistration', 'prereg', 'registration', 'rsvp', 'preregister'],
  map: ['map', 'googlemap', 'googlemaplink', 'maps'],
  social: ['social', 'socialmedia', 'socialmedialink', 'instagram'],
  website: ['website', 'site', 'url'],
  contact: ['contact', 'whatsapp', 'phone'],
  about: ['about', 'description'],
  notes: ['notes', 'note'],
  database: ['database', 'db', 'sheet'],
};
const DEFAULT_INDEX_FALLBACK: Record<string, number> = {
  id: 0,
  title: 1,
  venue: 2,
  organization: 2,
  location: 3,
  area: 4,
  activity: 5,
  dayOfWeek: 6,
  startTime: 7,
  endTime: 8,
  frequency: 9,
  frequencyNotes: 10,
  price: 11,
  preRegistration: 12,
  map: 13,
  social: 14,
  website: 15,
  contact: 16,
  about: 17,
  notes: 18,
};
export async function getEvents(cityOrTab?: CityConfig | string): Promise<Event[]> {
  try {
    let cityConfig: CityConfig;
    if (typeof cityOrTab === 'string') {
      cityConfig = CITIES[cityOrTab] || {
        slug: cityOrTab.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
        name: cityOrTab,
        region: '',
        heroLocation: cityOrTab,
        sheetTab: cityOrTab,
      };
    } else if (cityOrTab) {
      cityConfig = cityOrTab;
    } else {
      cityConfig = CITIES['medellin-colombia'];
    }
    const candidateUrls = getCandidateUrls(cityConfig);
    const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
    let rows: string[][] = [];
    for (const url of candidateUrls) {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            Accept: 'text/csv, application/json, text/plain, */*',
          },
          cache: isDev ? 'no-store' : 'default',
          next: isDev ? { revalidate: 0 } : { revalidate: 3600 },
        });
        if (response.ok) {
          const text = await response.text();
          const trimmed = text.trim();
          if (
            trimmed &&
            !trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE html') &&
            !trimmed.startsWith('<html') &&
            !trimmed.includes('accounts.google.com') &&
            !trimmed.includes('"status":"error"') &&
            !trimmed.includes('INVALID_QUERY')
          ) {
            const parsed = parseSheetData(trimmed);
            if (parsed.length >= 2) {
              rows = parsed;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (fetchErr) {
        console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Fetch error on ${url}:`, fetchErr);
      }
    }
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] No sheet data found for ${cityConfig.sheetTab}`);
      return [];
    }
    const headerRow = rows[0].map((h: string) => normalizeHeader(h));
    const headerIndexMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    Object.keys(HEADER_ALIASES).forEach((field) => {
      const aliases = HEADER_ALIASES[field];
      const foundIdx = headerRow.findIndex((h: string) => aliases.includes(h));
      if (foundIdx !== -1) {
        headerIndexMap[field] = foundIdx;
      }
    });
    const cleanCell = (cell: string): string => {
      const trimmed = (cell || '').trim();
      return trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x' ? '' : trimmed;
    };
    const dataRows = rows.slice(1);
    const events = dataRows
      .map((row): Event | null => {
        if (row.length === 0 || row.every((cell) => cleanCell(cell) === '')) return null;
        const getValue = (field: string): string => {
          const colIdx = headerIndexMap[field] ?? DEFAULT_INDEX_FALLBACK[field];
          if (colIdx !== undefined && colIdx < row.length) {
            return cleanCell(row[colIdx]);
          }
          return '';
        };
        const venueVal = getValue('venue');
        const orgVal = getValue('organization');
        const locVal = getValue('location');
        const rawActivity = getValue('activity');
        const act1 = getValue('activity1');
        const act2 = getValue('activity2');
        const act3 = getValue('activity3');
        let parsedActivities: string[] = [];
        if (rawActivity) {
          parsedActivities = rawActivity.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (parsedActivities.length === 0) {
          parsedActivities = [act1, act2, act3]
            .flatMap((s) => (s ? s.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()) : []))
            .filter(Boolean);
        }
        const uniqueActs: string[] = [];
        for (const act of parsedActivities) {
          if (!uniqueActs.some((u) => u.toLowerCase() === act.toLowerCase())) {
            uniqueActs.push(act);
          }
        }
        const activityStr = uniqueActs.join(', ');
        const rawDay = getValue('dayOfWeek');
        const dayOfWeekStr = normalizeDayOfWeek(rawDay);
        return {
          id: getValue('id'),
          title: getValue('title'),
          venue: venueVal,
          organization: orgVal || venueVal,
          location: locVal || venueVal,
          area: getValue('area'),
          activity: activityStr,
          activities: uniqueActs,
          dayOfWeek: dayOfWeekStr,
          startTime: getValue('startTime'),
          endTime: getValue('endTime'),
          frequency: getValue('frequency'),
          frequencyNotes: getValue('frequencyNotes'),
          price: getValue('price'),
          preRegistration: getValue('preRegistration'),
          map: getValue('map'),
          social: getValue('social'),
          website: getValue('website'),
          contact: getValue('contact'),
          about: getValue('about'),
          notes: getValue('notes'),
          database: getValue('database'),
        };
      })
      .filter((event): event is Event => event !== null);
    return events.filter((event) => Boolean(event.title));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching events:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

File: app/components/Header.tsx

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { CityConfig, getAllCities } from '../lib/cities';
import styles from './Header.module.css';
interface HeaderProps {
  city?: CityConfig;
  allCityOptions?: CityConfig[];
  cityCounts?: Record<string, number>;
}
export default function Header({
  city,
  allCityOptions,
  cityCounts = {},
}: HeaderProps) {
  const [citiesMenuOpen, setCitiesMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mobileDrawerOpen, setMobileDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const citiesMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const citiesList = useMemo(() => allCityOptions || getAllCities(), [allCityOptions]);
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (citiesMenuRef.current && !citiesMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setCitiesMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);
  const currentCityCount = city ? cityCounts[city.slug] : undefined;
  return (
    <>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div className={styles.headerInner}>
          <div className={styles.brandCol}>
            <Link
              href={city ? `/events/${city.slug}` : '/'}
              className={styles.brandLogoLink}
            >
              <Image
                src="/images/logo.svg"
                alt="Someplace Social"
                width={360}
                height={100}
                priority
                className={styles.logoImage}
              />
            </Link>
            {city && (
              <div className={styles.brandSubtitle}>
                {city.heroLocation}
                {typeof currentCityCount === 'number' && (
                  <> · {currentCityCount} {currentCityCount === 1 ? 'event' : 'events'} listed</>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <nav className={styles.navDesktop}>
            <div className={styles.citiesWrapper} ref={citiesMenuRef}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.citiesBtn}
                aria-expanded={citiesMenuOpen}
                onClick={() => setCitiesMenuOpen(!citiesMenuOpen)}
              >
                Cities
                <svg
                  width="14"
                  height="14"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2.4"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              {citiesMenuOpen && (
                <div className={styles.citiesDropdown}>
                  {citiesList.map((c) => {
                    const isActive = city?.slug === c.slug;
                    const count = cityCounts[c.slug];
                    return (
                      <Link
                        key={c.slug}
                        href={`/events/${c.slug}`}
                        className={`${styles.cityOption} ${
                          isActive ? styles.cityOptionActive : ''
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => setCitiesMenuOpen(false)}
                      >
                        <span className={styles.cityName}>{c.name}</span>
                        <div className={styles.cityOptionRight}>
                          {typeof count === 'number' && (
                            <span className={styles.cityEventCount}>
                              {count} {count === 1 ? 'event' : 'events'}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {isActive && (
                            <svg
                              width="16"
                              height="16"
                              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                              fill="none"
                              stroke="currentColor"
                              strokeWidth="2.4"
                              strokeLinecap="round"
                              strokeLinejoin="round"
                            >
                              <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" />
                            </svg>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <Link href="/about" className={styles.navLink}>
              About
            </Link>
            <Link href="/contact" className={styles.navLink}>
              Contact
            </Link>
            <Link href="/contact" className={styles.addEventBtn}>
              + Add event
            </Link>
          </nav>
          <div className={styles.navMobileActions}>
            <Link href="/contact" className={styles.mobileAddBtn}>
              + Add
            </Link>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.hamburgerBtn}
              aria-label="Open menu"
              onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(true)}
            >
              <svg
                width="24"
                height="24"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
              >
                <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      {mobileDrawerOpen && (
        <div
          className={styles.drawerBackdrop}
          onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className={styles.drawer}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
          >
            <div className={styles.drawerHeader}>
              <div className={styles.drawerTitle}>Someplace Social</div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.drawerCloseBtn}
                aria-label="Close menu"
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Choose City</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerCityList}>
              {citiesList.map((c) => {
                const isActive = city?.slug === c.slug;
                const count = cityCounts[c.slug];
                return (
                  <Link
                    key={c.slug}
                    href={`/events/${c.slug}`}
                    className={`${styles.drawerCityItem} ${
                      isActive ? styles.drawerCityItemActive : ''
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
                  >
                    <span>{c.name}</span>
                    <div className={styles.drawerCityItemRight}>
                      {typeof count === 'number' && (
                        <span className={styles.drawerCityCount}>
                          {count} {count === 1 ? 'event' : 'events'}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {isActive && <span>✓</span>}
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Navigation</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerNavLinks}>
              <Link
                href="/about"
                className={styles.drawerNavLink}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                About
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/contact"
                className={styles.drawerNavLink}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                Contact
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/contact"
                className={styles.drawerNavLink}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                + Add event
              </Link>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerFooter}>
              <a
                href="https://buymeacoffee.com/someplacesocial"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className={styles.drawerSupportBtn}
              >
                Buy me a drink
              </a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
